title: 907. Number of Music Playlists

examples.explanation: Every ordering of the 3 distinct songs works: 3! = 6.
Repeats are unrestricted (k = 0), so any of the 2^3 sequences with both songs present counts: 6.
Only [1,2,1] and [2,1,2] keep every repeat at distance greater than 1.
